'''Lex ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. At some point he defected from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and became part of the [[Order of Revan]], joining with the Revanite forces on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and becoming a walker pilot in the [[Sword Squadron (Revanites)|Sword Squadron]]. He and a fellow Revanite [[Cara (Revanite)|Cara]] were trying to stop a Coalition strike team from reaching the [[Temple of Sacrifice]], but were unsuccessful and were destroyed along with their walkers.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lex appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
